title: DAMN
blurb: Drawn out, slightly awed, and delivered on behalf of everybody watching. Here is the crowd reaction compressed into a single voice: something has just happened, it was worse than expected, and somebody needs to formally acknowledge it before the conversation can continue. Play it after a burn lands, a secret drops, or somebody gets comprehensively told in front of witnesses. It passes no judgement on whether the victim deserved any of it. That neutrality is why it fits everywhere, and it has fitted everywhere for a very long time.
